unlatched_review: Only the listed latch/lock parts lose collision; their visuals remain. Leaf, frame, handles and other hardware remain collidable.
hinge_axis_review: The listed vertically separated source barrels locate the axis. Their centers satisfy the 10 mm axis check; geometry is inferred, not manufacturer calibration.
modifications: Normalize the selected source to a centered, floor-aligned Z-up meter frame without reflection.
Apply only the recorded clearance, collider and hinge approximations; start closed and already unlatched.
hinge_contact_review: The ideal revolute joint replaces only the listed internal bearing contacts in solid, unbored source hardware. All colliders and unlisted contacts remain enabled.
hinge_jamb_review: The source has no mortise: moving barrels clip the jamb by about 2 mm. Filter only local jamb cells within 10 cm of the hinge axis against the listed barrels; retain all other frame contacts.
clearance_review: A 1.3% moving fit retreats each leaf edge about 5.44 mm to clear the fixed strike during opening. The opening remains centered and floor-aligned.
